name: debug
description: Drive a Debug Adapter Protocol adapter for the current session. Off by default (debug.enabled = false): this is an unsandboxed subprocess. Input {op, adapter?, program?, args?, source?, lines?, condition?, hitCondition?, variables_reference?, expression?, frame_id?}. Ops: launch, attach, set_breakpoints, continue, step_in, step_out, next, pause, stack_trace, scopes, variables, evaluate, disconnect, terminate.
llm_description: Session-scoped DAP debugger. Disabled unless debug.enabled=true. {op, adapter, program?, source?, lines?, condition?, hitCondition?, variables_reference?, expression?, frame_id?}. Ops: launch/attach/set_breakpoints/continue/step_in/step_out/next/pause/stack_trace/scopes/variables/evaluate/disconnect/terminate.

variables_reference.description: DAP variablesReference for a variables call.
